name.description: the name the provider knows it by

effort.description: the reasoning effort asked for unless a session says otherwise

usage.description: provider-reported token counts for one completed model request, stored on its ask entry; not cumulative and not a live context estimate

input_tokens.description: input context tokens, including cached tokens

total_tokens.description: total input and output tokens reported by the provider

cached_tokens.description: input tokens read from the provider cache; not a guarantee of future cache availability
